content: Kaasi mbuta-nganga wosu, bisi musola hana kati dya batu, bamusikununi kikuma kya batu muna kisalu kya Nzambi; ndangu katambikaka milambu yi bimenga kikuma kya masumu.
Bufwani ni kakala yi mbakisilu kikuma kya babana bazayiku mambu yi babana bisi ditotisa. Mudyambu yandi meni wáhitila muna lebakani.
Amana kikuma kya lebakani dyadina, kafweti tambika bimenga kikuma kya masumu ma yandi meni yi kikuma kya masumu ma batu bahika.
Kinga ka mutu ku wufwani mu kudiheka lukumu yandi meni, ho bámutediku kwena Nzambi, bwosu kákalabwa Loni.
Phila mosi, Kidisitu ka yandi meni ku wádiheka lukumu lwa kimbuta-nganga. Kábongilalwa kwena Nzambi wuna wámuzimbwala:
Muna bilumbu bya luzingu lwandi ha tsi, Yesu wátambika bisambu, kubokwadila yi matsanga kwena Nzambi wuna wakhana muhulula ku lufwa. Amana Nzambi wámuyuka kikuma kya bulemvu bwandi.
Keti bweti kákala kwandi Mwana wa Nzambi, wálonguka mu kulemvuka muna nzila ya bina kányokwakina.
Amana bwosu buna, Nzambi kámukitula mutu walunga, wákituka kisina kya luhulusu lwa konda tsuka kikuma kya mutu wosu wuna wisi mulemvwakila.
Nzambi wámusikununa mbuta-nganga muna mutindu wa Medikiseteki.
Mambu lawu thwenina mawu mu kuzonza matadidini dyambu dyadi, kaasi phasi mu kulutendwala, mukuma lwekina yi makokwa mu kubakula.

Tukidila thama wadi lwakituka kedi balongi, kaasi bafweti lulonga hika bikuma bya theti bya luyandiku bya ndinga za Nzambi. Kyadi kwena benu, mukuma yi lelu dyadi, mu kuyema lwenina kaka hana lwáfwana mu kudya madya ma ngolu.
Wosu wuna wisi zoluka mu kunwa mayeni mwana wa khunda kwandi kenina, kafwaniku kutenda mu kikuma kitadidini masonga.
Kaasi madya ma ngolu menina kikuma kya bambuta, kikuma kya babana benina yi katsatsa ka kuswasikisa, muna luzingu lwa kosu kilumbu, mambu mana menina ma mboti yi mana menina ma mbi.
